review:
Basically, it's a demo for [i]Broforce[/i] with characters from [i]The Expendables[/i]. It's quite short (about 20 minutes of gameplay), but it has a high rate of replayability and it's fun to play with some friends.

I'd recommend you play this game first before buying [i]Broforce[/i].
It's a fun game and a free preview of Broforce, just not as many levels. It's pretty fun, just don't expect to beat the game without dying a few times. 10/10 would play again

It's so good, my non-gamer wife loved playing it with me. In the end, I bought the Broforce game for the full experience. Also, worth mentioning, this game is intended to be played with somebody else. When I played it the first time, I played it by myself and got really tired of it initially.

Expendabros is basically a demo of Broforce. Maybe 10 levels to beat; which takes 20-30 min.

Not much replay value but it gives you a solid taste of what Broforce is: a Metal Slug-like designed in pixel art.
Or Metal Slug meets Minecraft, if you prefer.

Try it out, play with friends and then you'll probably want to buy Broforce - especially while it's on sales - if you feel like playing with more content (more characters, more weapons, more levels). 

HF!

So this is basically a Broforce demo. As you can see by my review and other reviews you get about an hour of game time for the trouble of installing, which is more than enough time for you to figure out if you enjoy what these developers are putting together. This snack-sized game is definitely full of fun but it's not too memorable on its own. As soon as you start to get used to the way the game plays the demo is over. The full Broforce game plays more smoothly, has many more bros to unlock, has way more to do, and is full of all kinds of personality. If you take the time to play this game and enjoy it even a little bit, I don't think the full game will disappoint you.
Short, sweet, free. If you were curious about Broforce, give this a run and see if you like it. Broforce (most likely) runs better than Expendabros, keep that in mind.
